description: Only compare APIs and software-service providers for a buyer task (e.g. OCR, extraction, translation, scraping). NOT for general research, travel planning, legal/ISO standards analysis or document analysis. For other intents, first use free via_list_services to find a suitable VIA service; do not pay for an unrelated comparison. Pay 0.01 USDC on Base with an authorized x402 wallet, or 0.01 USD of prepaid VIA credit if your MCP connection has an x-credit-token header. Prepaid calls require requestId: a fresh UUID per task, reused only to retry the same task without another debit. Returns a recommendation and alternatives. Supplier purchase is separate.

requestId.description: Required for prepaid credit. New UUID per task; preserve it for retries of identical input.
